items.title: ULTIMATE KREA 2 LoRA Training! Get PERFECT RESULTS!
items.summary:
KREA 2 is already one of the most creative and visually impressive open image generation models available, and now you can train your own custom LoRAs for it too!

After spending days testing different datasets, training settings and LoRA configurations, I found the best way to train KREA 2 LoRAs while keeping strong character likeness, accurate styles, good prompt following and beautiful image quality.

In this video, I’ll show you how to prepare and caption your training images, choose the correct AI-Toolkit settings, start your training in just a few clicks and test your finished LoRA. I’ll also explain the most important parameters, show you how to train both characters and artistic styles, and share the settings that gave me the best results.

By the end of this video, you’ll have everything you need to train your own KREA 2 LoRAs locally or on RunPod and create custom characters, people and art styles with full freedom!

What do YOU think of KREA 2 LoRA training? Let me know in the comments below!👇

items.title: MiniCPM5 - Just How Good Can a 1B Model Be?
